description: Cross-language conformance corpus for the query language. Every client (Go, JavaScript over WASM, and any language over the C library) runs these cases against the real engine so grammar drift becomes a failing build. Numeric expectations use tolerance; error checks are non-empty/substring (wording may change); expectCode names the parser failure code, which never changes once shipped.
